title: BrowserSession
description: Represents a single programmable browser session provisioned by a headless browser library or browser-as-a-service platform.

id.description: Stable identifier for the browser session.

provider.description: Browser provider or library that created the session.

engine.description: Underlying browser engine driving the session.

headless.description: Whether the browser is running without a visible UI.

viewport.description: Viewport dimensions used when rendering pages.

user_agent.description: User-Agent string presented by the browser session.
user_agent.example: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

proxy.description: Proxy configuration applied to the session.

stealth.description: Whether anti-bot fingerprint patching is enabled for the session.

profile_id.description: Identifier of a persisted browser profile reused by this session, if any.

connection_url.description: WebSocket or CDP endpoint that a client connects to in order to drive the session.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the session.
